title: Fixed authored botanical details
art_status: Original structural art proxies made with code. Not scanned botanical assets, survey records, or a completed photoreal plant pass.
season: Illustrative midsummer flowering state; phenology has not been calibrated to a date.
units: metres; positions use world.json local east/south frame; y is read from current terrain at bake time.
scope: 30 individually authored clumps, entirely nonthermal. No random placement or runtime procedural population.
asset_replacement: Replace meshes under the same placement IDs with botanically reviewed licensed models. See docs/ecology-research.md and asset research for the Rufus Rockwell lupine candidate; that third-party model is not bundled here.
